name: expense-api

dependencies.name: currency-service
dependencies.description: Converts a foreign-currency expense amount to the household's home currency before it is stored/reported.

description: The backend for the household expense tracker: owns expenses, categories, category limits, and period totals for the shared household ledger. Validates the caller's identity (via the gateway-injected token from Thunder), persists all data in expense-db, and calls the currency-conversion capability to normalize foreign-currency expenses to the household's home currency. Does not render any UI and does not send notifications.
